reasoning: The agent runs a consistent verification-driven loop: when tests fail it reads the relevant source and tests, edits, then re-verifies (anchor 5). Two episodes go further — the multi-edit rework of workbook.py's dependency recompute (131-170) and the cross-layer parser/eval overhaul for array literals (206-228) — which show reworking underlying design rather than piling on local patches (toward anchor 8). But the log shows no visible root-cause diagnosis, no early/proactive divergence detection, and no perf-limit adaptation, and much activity is mechanical restart churn, so it falls short of 8. This places observed behavior at 6.
